name: Encrypted Parchment
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Encrypted Parchment sends proven novice orc rogues into the Den. Its cipher points them to Rwag, an agent of the Shattered Hand.

sections.title: A Coded Summons
sections.body: Gornek passes the coded parchment to novice orcs who have proved themselves against the local wildlife. Other trainers recruit pupils openly in the clearing, but rogue instructor Rwag sends his summons by cipher. The message directs you beyond the sunlit camp and deep into the cavern called the Den.

sections.title: Eyes in the Shadows
sections.body: Inside the Den, you find Rwag keeping watch among the rock. Warlocks lurk deeper in the cave, and he tells you he watches recruits for the Shattered Hand. While orcish society prizes open honor and glory in battle, the Shattered Hand works as the Horde's hidden network of spies, cutthroats, and gatherers of intelligence.

faq.answer: Rwag, the rogue trainer in the Valley of Trials, writes the parchment. He has Gornek deliver the coded message to promising young orcs after they complete their first trials.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: why do i need encrypted parchment
faq.answer: The parchment guides orc rogues to Rwag in the Den, where their formal training begins. He teaches stealth, lockpicking, and martial subterfuge.
Rwag hides inside the Den, a dark cavern on the northern side of the Valley of Trials. He keeps near the entrance, wary of the warlocks deeper inside.
The cipher keeps wandering brutes and curious outsiders from reading the summons. It also tests whether the initiate can decode a covert message.

The Shattered Hand began as an infamous orc clan known for self-mutilation. In Thrall's Horde, it is an organization of scouts, assassins, and covert agents that works from the shadows to protect Horde interests.
Nartok is a warlock trainer deeper in the Den. Rwag distrusts the dark spellcasters who openly conduct fel rituals in the cave's deepest corners.

angles.text: As a rogue, this parchment marks your induction into the Horde's covert ranks. It introduces you to Rwag and your first professional training.
As an orc, you balance ancestral discipline with the quiet cunning demanded by the Shattered Hand, unlike warriors who seek open, bloodthirsty glory.
As a member of the Horde, you know that even an honorable warchief like Thrall needs spies and scouts to protect Durotar's young lands from hidden threats.
